notes: Sua loi scrcpy chet tren nhieu may ("read codec id: unexpected end of file"): APK nap lib trong chinh APK thay vi file libdaomai_cv.so cu o /data/local/tmp, kiem symbol, khong de luong video chet; app cai de APK moi (versionCode theo build), pm install hong thi chay tu file da day; o hien dung ly do loi cua scrcpy. Da PC doi xung: moi PC vua server vua node, chi can nhap ip:port; tab moi (may tren PC nay tick = chia se, moi peer mot nhom gap, tick = noi, chip so may); A va B tro lan nhau khong de quy (adb DaoMai 6.5.1 nhung san).
